summary: Iter22 — Frontend-only smoke + static review of new 10-tap Scout Mode workflow (ScoutMode.jsx v5.0 + MarkerStudio.handleScoutConfirm rewrite). Login as testfree-mar@elitescout.com / Free@2026! → /upload → attach /tmp/sample_clip.mp4 (~120 KB, H.264 mp4 generated via ffmpeg lavfi testsrc) → click LOCK ONTO YOUR PLAYER → MarkerStudio fullscreen opens (top bar 'LOCK ONTO YOUR PLAYER', NAVIGATE / MARK BOX tabs, timeline 0:00/0:00). Scout Mode (data-testid='scout-mode-overlay') did NOT auto-open in the headless Chromium session. Root cause matches iter20/iter21's documented env limitation: MarkerStudio's parent <video> never fires loadedmetadata for the blob H.264 mp4 in headless Chromium → videoReady stays false → the 250 ms setTimeout in MarkerStudio.jsx:1227 that calls setScoutOpen(true) never triggers. Confirmed via runtime ('0:00 / 0:00' timestamp in studio header). 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors across landing, login, /upload, MarkerStudio. Landing CTA 'UPLOAD YOUR VIDEO' clickable and visible. Cookie banner present (rejected during test). Static code review of the recent rewrites confirmed all required wiring (see critical_code_review_comments).

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise Scout Mode auto-open in headless Chromium because the parent MarkerStudio <video> never emits loadedmetadata for the blob-URL H.264 mp4 → videoReady stays false → setScoutOpen(true) never fires. This is the same Chromium-headless decoder gap documented in iter20/iter21; static code path is correct (MarkerStudio.jsx L1218-1229).

action_items: OPTIONAL (test-infra): ship a small WebM/VP9 fixture (~5-15 s, contains at least one visible silhouette so MediaPipe yields detections in MarkerStudio's roster scan path) under /app/frontend/public/test-fixtures/ so future Playwright runs can drive the parent <video> to loadedmetadata in headless Chromium and exercise scout-mode-overlay auto-open + the full 10-tap flow end-to-end. Today the H.264 testsrc mp4 attaches OK but its blob URL never reaches readyState>=1 in headless Chromium.

OPTIONAL (defensive): in MarkerStudio.jsx:1218-1229 the auto-open is gated only on videoReady. Consider an additional fallback: if 5 s after `open && !scoutOpen && !videoReady && anchors.length===0`, surface a 'Tap to start Scout Mode' button so a user on an exotic codec / slow network never sees a silent black studio. Static review only — not observed as a bug in production.
NO PRODUCT FIX REQUIRED for this iteration's frontend rewrite — static review of ScoutMode.jsx v5.0 + handleScoutConfirm rewrite is clean and matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: ScoutMode.jsx (NEW v5.0, 868 lines) — all spec testids present: scout-mode-overlay (L470), scout-close (L477), scout-mode-title (L483), scout-stage (L493), scout-draft-marker (L592), scout-draft-resize (L612), scout-progress-counter (L741), scout-retap (L789), scout-confirm-mark (L799), scout-skip-frame (L812), scout-finish-early (L823), scout-zoom-out (L836), scout-zoom-reset (L845), scout-zoom-in (L855). MIN_REQUIRED=3 (L35) gates scout-finish-early visibility (L718 `canFinish = confirmedCount >= MIN_REQUIRED`).

ScoutMode.jsx PremiumBootOverlay (L634-699) renders the required premium loading screen: SVG progress ring with pct readout, three rotating stage labels ('Uploading video' / 'Analysing footage' / 'Generating player screenshots'), and a 'SCOUTING INSIGHT' ticker that rotates every 4000 ms across 8 strings (L40-49, L637). bootProgress advances in 4 phases (5%→15% wait, 15%→45% scene-detect, 45%→100% frame capture, then 1.0) — no frozen-zero state.

ScoutMode.jsx handleConfirmMark (L404-415) correctly writes marks[currentHintIdx] then setTimeout(advance,350) — gives the user a 'locked' visual beat before auto-advancing. handleSkipFrame (L417-425) writes {skipped:true} and advances WITHOUT incrementing confirmedCount (computed L373-376 via `!m.skipped` filter) — so 'Not visible · next frame' increases FRAME counter but NOT the X/10 confirmed counter (matches the spec).

ScoutMode.jsx DONE-phase effect (L437-462) correctly: sorts marks by hint index, maps to {t, box, segment}, computes markerImageDataUrl=frameCache[firstIdx].jpegDataUrl, and calls onConfirm({anchors, sceneCuts, markerImageDataUrl}). Includes a defensive fallback to MARKING if anchors.length < MIN_REQUIRED (L451-454).

MarkerStudio.jsx handleScoutConfirm (L1339-1372) — the regression-target rewrite — correctly bails with toast.error if markerImageDataUrl is missing (no longer touches the (unmounted) parent videoRef), converts data URL → Blob via fetch().then(r=>r.blob()), guards against zero-byte blobs, then calls onConfirm({markerBlob, markerTimestamp:first.t, markerBox:first.box, markerAnchors:[…], sceneCuts, scoutMode:true}) and closes Scout Mode via setScoutOpen(false). This is exactly the fix described in the agent-to-agent note: the old code that tried to grab the frame from a null videoRef.current is gone.

MarkerStudio.jsx auto-open effect (L1218-1229) opens Scout Mode 250 ms after `open && videoReady && !scoutOpen && anchors.length===0`. Correct — but see action item: in headless Chromium with blob mp4 sources, videoReady never flips → Scout Mode never auto-opens at test time. Production iOS Safari / desktop Chrome should be fine (real codec).
MarkerStudio.jsx still ~2214 lines — split-into-hooks recommendation from iter18/19/20/21 still outstanding (now includes a Scout-Mode integration layer).
Build hygiene: 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors observed during login → upload → MarkerStudio open. Bundle still builds clean (no compile warnings in the live preview).

success_rate.frontend: Static review 100% green on ScoutMode v5.0 + handleScoutConfirm rewrite. Runtime smoke 60% — landing/login/upload/MarkerStudio-open all green; Scout Mode auto-open + the 10-tap flow itself could not be runtime-exercised in headless Chromium due to the documented mp4-blob decoder gap (env limitation, not a product bug).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 10-tap Scout Mode flow cannot be runtime-exercised in headless Chromium with the current ffmpeg-testsrc mp4 fixture because MarkerStudio's parent <video> never reaches readyState>=1 for blob H.264 sources in this container. To unblock end-to-end coverage, commit a small VP9/WebM clip with at least one visible person under /app/frontend/public/test-fixtures/ and have the test attach that file. Once videoReady fires, MarkerStudio.jsx:1227 will auto-open Scout Mode after 250 ms, and the full BOOT → MARKING → DONE pipeline (tap → confirm → skip → finish early) can be driven via the documented testids. Static review confirms the entire new code path is wired correctly and matches the spec — no product fix needed.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found in this iteration's rewrite. The runtime gap (Scout Mode never auto-opened in headless Chromium during this test) is a recurring container/codec limitation: Chromium-headless on this preview container cannot decode H.264 mp4 served via blob: URLs, so MarkerStudio's <video> never fires loadedmetadata/loadeddata, videoReady stays false, and the setScoutOpen(true) timer (MarkerStudio.jsx L1227) never arms. Mitigation: ship a VP9/WebM fixture (see action_items) so future runs can drive videoReady=true. Real users on iOS Safari / desktop Chrome / Firefox with real codecs are unaffected — this is purely a test-env gap, and identical to the codec gap documented in iter20 and iter21.
